summary: Tested iteration 3 (SEO + Shipping/Tax engine + Admin Console) end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass. Frontend: 16/16 Playwright assertions pass. Sitemap.xml + robots.txt are well-formed and contain expected paths/slugs. /api/cart/quote correctly applies $25/$35/$55 per-category shipping with the highest-tier-wins rule and free-shipping at $250. POST /api/checkout/session returns the new {url, session_id, amount, subtotal, shipping} shape with cs_test_-prefixed id; the regression session (cs_test_a1iMM98...) still returns status:complete payment_status:paid. Admin magic-link auth works (silent no-op for non-admin emails, 403 for non-OPS tokens, 401 for garbage). Role enforcement is bidirectional: maker JWT is rejected on admin endpoints with 403 and admin JWT is rejected on /api/maker/me with 403. Admin list endpoints return arrays without _id. PATCH approve/reject persists, PATCH custom-order quote returns {status:'quoted', quote, ...}, both fire BackgroundTasks. UI: Product page injects @type=Product JSON-LD with price 149 and document title 'Mountain Range Silhouette · Crafters Market'; Maker page injects @type=Organization. /cart shows row-shipping=$25.00, cart-total=$174.00, free-shipping-banner='Add $101.00 for free shipping'. /admin/login shows admin-login-sent after submit. /admin/verify with bad token shows admin-verify-back; with valid token redirects to /admin/dashboard, stores cm_admin_jwt. Dashboard renders all 4 stats + 3 tabs; approve button updates row to 'approved'; quote send works; logout clears jwt and returns to /admin/login; /admin/dashboard without jwt redirects to /admin/login. footer-admin-link is now an <a href='/admin/login'> Link. Test data was restored after PATCH tests (status/note/quote fields unset).

minor.issue: Still constructs webhook_url from request.base_url for the old StripeCheckout instance; not used in the new SDK retrieve path so non-blocking. Carry-over from iteration_2.

action_items: No blocking action items. All three features (SEO, Shipping/Tax engine, Admin Console) work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 953 lines and rapidly approaching the 700-line split threshold. Recommend extracting the SEO block (sitemap/robots), the cart/checkout block, and the Admin Console block into routers/seo.py, routers/checkout.py, routers/admin.py — each is already a clean self-contained section.

/api/admin/auth/request always returns {sent:true} even when ADMIN_EMAIL env var is empty (fail-open). If OPS_EMAIL is ever unset in prod, the endpoint silently swallows every request and never issues a token, but the UI shows 'Link Sent ✓'. Consider asserting ADMIN_EMAIL at startup and 503'ing if missing.
Single-admin model is hardcoded to OPS_EMAIL. Adding a second operator requires a code change + redeploy. Future-proof by reading a comma-separated ADMIN_EMAILS list.
PATCH /admin/maker-applications/{id} sets {status, note, decided_at} but does not record decided_by (the admin email from claims). For audit trails this should be persisted.

_site_root falls back to PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL which is the API host — sitemap should ideally point to the public site origin (PUBLIC_SITE_URL is checked first but is not set in /app/backend/.env, so canonical URLs in sitemap currently use the backend hostname). Set PUBLIC_SITE_URL or default to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
ld+json on the Product page hardcodes the offer; verify currency/availability fields are present (only price was asserted in tests).
/api/cart/quote returns total_before_tax but the response key used in the spec is 'total' for the UI; the FE reads shipping + subtotal directly so this is fine, but rename for clarity.
